nc.description: A light grey, segmented ring structure is shown with one of its curved sections hinged open.
Inside an open, geometric housing, two robotic arms press down on a line of individual blocks that transition into a continuous, twisted ribbon.
A close-up view shows an untextured, grey 3D model of a mechanical linkage consisting of interconnected rods, hinges, and base plates with rounded protrusions.
A light gray 3D rendering shows a static assembly consisting of a rectangular block connected by a rod to a central cylindrical hub, from which an angled arm and two parallel, split rings extend.
A central white component is surrounded by eight identical bracket-shaped parts and radiating lines of small cylindrical pegs arranged on a white background.

vc.description: A close-up displays a mechanical assembly consisting of interlocking gears, metal linkages, and grey structural parts surrounding a central white component.
A grey model illustrates a mechanical joint connecting a segmented shaft to a threaded rod via a central housing containing meshed gears and linkages.
A monochrome 3D rendering displays a mechanical assembly featuring a four-armed crank mechanism and a hovering cap positioned above four pipe fittings resting on wood-textured blocks.
A mechanical assembly is shown featuring a pedal connected by linkages to a spring-loaded shaft with gears, mounted on a base bracket.
A central metal gear mechanism is surrounded by disassembled grey plastic housing components and screws arranged in a radial pattern on a white background.
